title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Soda Guava Passion 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Take your tastebuds on a tropical tour with Guava Passion from Doozy Vape Co’s Seriously Soda collection. The rich, tropical tang of Guava greets you on the inhale followed by the deep, dark sweetness of authentic Passion Fruit, and all lifted with a light soda rush on the exhale for true refreshment. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks.
